args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a protective mana barrier shaped like a tall closed oval glass capsule standing on the ground, big enough to hold one standing small person, a thin glowing indigo and sky-blue rim all the way around, glass-like white reflection streaks curving along the left upper side. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster, glowing energy parts bright with a hot near-white rim fading to saturated indigo and sky-blue, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. The inside of the shell is EMPTY and see-through (transparent), only the glassy shell, its rim and reflections are drawn. No crosses, no star or crescent symbols, no letters or runes. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no silhouettes, no creatures, no weapons, no text, transparent background.
